name: Monticello and the University of Virginia in Charlottesville
description: Just outside Charlottesville, Virginia, Monticello is the hilltop mansion Thomas Jefferson designed and kept reworking for decades, borrowing from Italian Renaissance architect Palladio. Its name means "little mountain" in Italian. It was also a plantation worked by enslaved people, whose workshops and quarters along Mulberry Row can still be traced. Jefferson's nearby University of Virginia centres on his columned "academical village.
